name: repo-min
description: Disposable fixture repository for coding benchmarks. Recreated before every coding run so no mode inherits another's edits.

files.content:
# Minimal disposable repository fixture

This repository exists only so repository-modification benchmarks have somewhere
safe to write. It is recreated from `fixture.json` before every coding run, so
one mode's edits can never help or distort the next mode.

Do not add real code here. The only files that matter are the ones a benchmark
scenario names.

# Task note

This file is the target of the `repo-modify-disposable` live scenario.

Each coding run must start from a clean copy of this file, so "the change was
made" always means "the change was made in this run".
